quote: Motivated by how humans solve complex problems by noting down intermediary results, introduced chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning.
Our analysis, we assume rational (rather than real) arithmetic for all definitions and computations.
We do not give a training algorithm to elicit the emergence of specific Turing complete or non-deterministic regular automata in neural LMs...
We make no claims about the training efficiency or even the feasibility of training neural LMs for this purpose.
